description: Explain one Lintsure rule in plain words: what it looks for, which framework controls it relates to (for example GDPR Art. 32 or OWASP A05), why it matters and how to fix it. Use after scan, when the user asks about a finding ('what does pii.logged mean?', 'why is this a problem?'). Returns text; read-only.

ruleId.description: The rule id shown on a scan finding. Examples: "pii.logged" (personal data in logs), "secret.in-source", "supabase.rls-disabled". The full list is at lintsure.com/rules.

name: explain_rule
